course_name: CMOS元件量測與可靠度工程
outline: Through this course, we expect and culture that the graduate students can figure out the MOS device characteristics and measurement technique following submicron and nano-node Si processes. The related process variation impacting the device performance will be delicately probed. Additionally, the device and product reliability in test items and analysis skill is mainly focused, too.
schedule:
Week		Outline content
01		Introduction
02		Semiconductor materials
03		Quantum effect
04		Passive devices
05		Characteristics of passive devices
06		Active devices
07		Characteristics of active devices
08		Parameters of active devices
09		Mid-term exam.
10		Pattern designs
11	         Pattern designs
12		Parameter extraction
13		Parameter extraction (including charge pumping)
14		Oxide reliability analysis
15		Hot carrier effect
16		Metal migration analysis
17		Product reliability analysis (including ESD)
18		Final exam
assessment:
Grading:
1.	Midterm Exam.: 20%
2.	Final Exam: 30%
3.	Quiz or presentation: 50%
